protocol.prefix_len: L = max(1, round(f * n_steps)); features use steps 0..L-1 only
protocol.rows: identical rows and folds for every method

noise_floor.note: temperature-0 API inference flips about 9% of per-instance outcomes on this corpus, so any within-instance contrast has a ~9% label-flip floor; runs-per-instance is reported next to every within-instance claim

integrity_checks.label_source: results/rebuild/gold_patches.parquet (the dataset's own patch field, independent of the agent's output)
integrity_checks.no_lookahead: features read steps 0..L-1 only; --selftest corrupts every later step and asserts the features are unchanged
integrity_checks.position_is_a_full_run_quantity: position = prefix length = round(f*n_steps), so it encodes the run's length; reported as the study's baseline and flagged as a leak diagnostic.  The own_rates family excludes it and every other length-carrying column.
integrity_checks.count_features_are_length_carrying: own_all adds raw counts that grow with the prefix; own_rates is the leak-free variant

within_instance.metric: per-instance AUC of the prefix failure detector (own_rates)
within_instance.noise_floor_note: temperature-0 API inference flips about 9% of per-instance outcomes on this corpus, so any within-instance contrast has a ~9% label-flip floor; runs-per-instance is reported next to every within-instance claim

y_fail.design: whole-task train(50%)/calibration(25%)/test(25%) split; null = negative runs of the calibration block

y_mode.design: whole-task train(50%)/calibration(25%)/test(25%) split; null = negative runs of the calibration block

null_checks.note: a null run (one that never fails) must not be flagged as a matter of course; the achieved flag rate is measured here rather than asserted to be zero.  The withdrawn frozen-study claim came from scoring a detector against its own statistic; here the label is the gold patch and the score is prefix-only.

0.1.definition: credit 1.0 if routed to the run's true mode, lambda otherwise
